catalog.title: Policy Stake Briefs
catalog.intro: Each brief takes one bill and asks, one step at a time, what the bill would cause and whether those consequences give a reason to support or oppose it for each of six values. You decide whether the evidence supports each claim. Anyone can read the briefs. Assigned reviewers sign in with Google to save their answers to their reviewer account and can download a backup copy at any time.

review_copy.public_tree_intro: Read each decision and its evidence. Sign in with Google to record answers to your reviewer account.
review_copy.public_final_guide: Each value’s result comes from your current answers in this session.
review_copy.local_only: Your review is saved to your reviewer account. Each change is kept first in this browser and then sent to the server; it counts as saved only when the server confirms it. To keep a separate copy, export a JSON backup.
review_copy.lock_unavailable: This browser cannot reserve a single writing tab. Review is read-only here. Use a browser that supports Web Locks to record answers.
review_copy.import_error: This backup could not be imported. Use an unedited JSON backup from this exact release. Your current session is unchanged.
